items.title: Acceleration in clean technology needed to ensure decline in world's emissions: Study
items.summary: Adopting clean energy solutions such as solar, wind, and electric vehicles can play a pivotal role in lowering carbon emissions. The Global Carbon Project highlights a concerning forecast of rising emissions in India that may exceed earlier predictions. While many nations are successfully decreasing fossil fuel emissions, a rapid shift to cleaner energy sources is critical, as our carbon budget is narrowing, demanding immediate action to meet 2028 emission goals.

items.title: Karnataka plans feasibility studies for 1,500 MW floating solar capacity
items.summary: Karnataka is currently exploring the establishment of floating solar power projects aimed at generating 1,500 MW capacity. The initiative includes conducting feasibility studies and surveys for suitable reservoirs and water bodies. KPCL will evaluate technical aspects and environmental impacts as part of project preparation. This project reflects the state's commitment to innovative renewable energy solutions while optimizing land and water resources.

items.title: This EPC stock under ₹15 hits 20% upper circuit after ₹510 crore bank guarantee release boosts order execution
items.summary: Jyoti Structures shares surged 20% to ₹13 after lenders began releasing ₹510.59 crore in bank guarantees and letters of credit under its NCLT-approved resolution plan.

Experts recommend gold for conservative investors and portfolio diversification, while viewing silver as a riskier opportunity with potential upside. They advise gradual accumulation and note key technical support levels.

items.title: Beyond Business: The Leadership Philosophy of T. Kishan Singh
items.summary: T. Kishan Singh highlights the influence of his father's dedication on his professional journey in the paper industry. He stresses the role of sustainable practices and customer relationships for long-term business success. Health and fitness are prioritized as essential elements for effective leadership and overall well-being. Singh shares that consistency and resilience are vital in navigating challenges, both personally and professionally.

items.summary: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone intends to acquire Evos BV, a Netherlands-based liquid storage operator. The all-cash transaction, valued at 2.56 billion euros, emphasizes strategic international expansion. The acquisition aims to enhance Adani Ports' liquid portfolio with new-age transition fuels, reflecting its growth strategy. S&P Global Ratings predicts Evos could contribute 9 percent of Adani Ports' total EBITDA by fiscal 2029.

Markets had opened sharply higher after the Diwali holiday, with the Nifty gap-opening near 25,338 and Bank Nifty near 60,525, before trimming some gains through the morning session.

items.summary: While the Nifty 50 has rallied nearly 11% in a month, several midcap stocks have outperformed the broader index. Here are 12 midcap stocks that have surged between 15% and 30% during this period, according to ACE Equity data.

items.title: Apollo Micro Systems shares surge 10%: Defence multibagger stock rallies 3,640% in 5 years; can it rise further?
items.summary: Apollo Micro Systems shares rose as much as 10.5% on Wednesday, outperforming the defence index. The company reported strong Q2 FY27 results, with profit up 54%, revenue up 72% and a record ₹1,765 crore order book. Brokerages remain positive, citing growth potential.

items.summary: Strong revenue growth and positive management commentary on festive and wedding-season demand also supported investor sentiment.

items.title: Rupee touches strongest since April as foreign inflows offset firm dollar
items.summary: On Wednesday, the Indian rupee surged to its healthiest value since April, closing at 93.69 against the dollar. This upswing was driven by a remarkable influx of foreign investments in local stocks, totaling nearly $6 billion in November. Even in light of a stronger dollar amid US inflation signals, the rupee stood firm. There's a notable optimistic shift in market sentiment, now eager for India's inflation data anticipated for October.

items.title: India will need additional 25,000 EV fast chargers in next 3 years: Exicom CEO
items.summary: India is projected to require an increased number of DC fast chargers to support electric vehicle sales growth. An estimate suggests that around 25,000 more chargers will be needed over the next three years. This requirement accounts for the expected growth in passenger vehicles, buses, and trucks. Exicom Tele-Systems has supplied a significant number of charging stations and aims for ongoing growth in this sector.

items.title: ET AI Business Transformation Masterclass heads to IIM Bangalore to decode enterprise AI adoption
items.summary: The AI Business Transformation Masterclass & Awards 2026 at IIM Bangalore will feature leaders from IndusInd Bank, PhonePe, PepsiCo, Shadowfax, Myntra, Shopify, NVIDIA and other organisations. Sessions will cover agentic AI, voice technology, supply chains, contextual commerce and physical AI, followed by the ET Most Innovative AI Product Awards 2026.

ICICI Prudential Life Insurance and PI Industries may be removed, with estimated outflows of $263 million.

items.title: Tea industry groups back panel's proposal for minimum sustainable price as costs outpace prices
items.summary: Five tea industry associations have welcomed the government committee's recommendation for a minimum sustainable price for tea. This recommendation aims to address rising production costs that are exceeding the prices received by producers. The proposed benchmark price is linked to wage movements and consumer price indices, which will be reviewed periodically. Producers believe this pricing mechanism will help absorb wage increases and support investment in tea production.

items.title: Deepinder Goyal's $900 Temple wearable faces scrutiny over brain blood-flow claims
items.summary: Temple, a new wearable device, claims to track blood flow to the brain and other health metrics. Indian doctors express concerns over the validity of these claims, asking for regulatory scrutiny. Some sportspersons promote the device, while critics label it a gimmick without formal medical approvals. Developer Deepinder Goyal states the device is a wellness tracker, not a medical one.

items.title: Moody's ups India's FY27 growth forecast to 7% on strong economic momentum, warns of risks
items.summary: Moody's has raised India's FY27 growth forecast to 7% from 6.5%, citing strong economic momentum and resilience to energy shocks. However, it flagged inflationary pressures, a deficient monsoon and rising El Niño risks as potential threats to growth.

items.title: Equity inflows of MFs dip 14% on volatile market
items.summary: Investors shift to large-caps as inflows surge nearly 10 fold; mid and small-cap funds lose momentum.

This classification indicates that although objectionable conditions were found in the Telangana manufacturing facility, the absence of immediate regulatory action allows the company to address the issues through voluntary corrective measures.

These options include quick loan disbursements and flexible repayment plans for customers. The agreement also features a 25 percent assured buyback guarantee to enhance vehicle resale value. This initiative aims to support the transition to electric mobility for commercial vehicle users in India.

items.title: Bengaluru Metro Blue Line moves closer to airport connectivity: Train completes 6-km trial run from Byappanahalli to Doddanekundi on the 58-km corridor between Central Silk Board and Kempegowda International Airport
items.summary: Bengaluru Namma Metro Blue Line trial has moved from Byappanahalli to KR Puram and Doddanekundi, taking the 58.19 km corridor to Kempegowda International Airport closer to mainline testing. Work continues near Central Silk Board, and inspections will take months. The 7.5 km Pink Line opens on November 13.

items.title: Provisional registration framework proposed for allied healthcare professionals
items.summary: The National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions has proposed a provisional registration framework for eligible professionals, with provisions for bridge courses, supervised clinical training and competency assessments before regular registration. The draft regulations also propose an online registration system and invite public and stakeholder feedback until December 4.

The project's estimated cost is nearly 688 billion rupees and is expected to take about six years to complete. The first phase will specifically link Chhattisgarh, Odisha, and West Bengal.

items.summary: By 2030, Bata India plans to achieve remarkable growth by doubling its turnover and profits. To attract a younger demographic, the company is rolling out innovative sneakers and casual footwear. The 'Reignite India 2030' initiative outlines its strategy for sustained growth, including introducing diverse global products and prioritizing franchisee developments while reviewing new opportunities for its own retail stores.

items.title: Railway stocks on fast track! RVNL, IRFC jump up to 10% amid Sensex, Nifty rise | What's behind momentum? Key levels

items.title: India holds Pernod, Diageo Scotch shipments as investigators seek 150% tariff
items.summary: Indian customs has detained dozens of containers of bulk Scotch imported by Pernod Ricard and Diageo, seeking a 150% tariff instead of the reduced 75% duty under the India-UK trade pact. items.title: India's unemployment rate falls to 5.1% in July-September as rural joblessness declines
items.summary: India's unemployment rate saw a decline to 5.1% from 5.4% in the prior quarter. The decrease in unemployment primarily occurred in rural areas, where it fell to 4.3%. The survey indicated that more individuals were either working or seeking jobs during this period. Women's employment participation also improved, rising to 34.7% from 33.2%. The overall employment figure reached approximately 57.9 crore individuals in India.

items.title: Budget 2027-28: PHDCCI urges govt to scrap LTCG tax on equities, cut STCG tax to 10%
items.summary: PHD Chamber of Commerce and Industry has made recommendations for the Union Budget 2027-28. They have proposed abolishing long-term capital gains tax and reducing short-term capital gains tax rates. The chamber has also called for relaxed loan repayment norms and higher loan limits for MSMEs. They highlighted the economic significance of MSMEs in India's GDP and employment. Improved access to credit and equity support could enhance India's global manufacturing position.

items.title: India's wheat plantings seen at record high but final output to depend on weather, FAO says
items.summary: India is poised for record wheat planting this season, supported by government incentives and soil moisture. The final wheat output will depend significantly on weather patterns influenced by El Nino in April and May. El Nino typically brings above-average rainfall to key wheat-growing areas but may also increase flooding risks. Adequate snow cover from expected precipitation could benefit both overwintering crops and reservoir replenishment.

items.title: India in a 'sweet spot' amid oil volatility and currency dynamics: Kotak Neo's Anindya Banerjee
items.summary: India is in a favourable economic position due to declining crude oil prices and increasing foreign investment inflows. The Indian rupee is currently undervalued, and there is potential for appreciation if geopolitical tensions ease. Expectations suggest one more interest rate hike from both the Federal Reserve and the Reserve Bank of India. Additionally, shifting global investment sentiment is favoring markets such as India beyond artificial intelligence stocks.
